class.name: OcgPrsmgrPresentationmanager
class.brief_description: A framework to manage 3D displays, graphic entities and their updates. Used in the AIS package (Application Interactive Services), to enable the advanced user to define the default display mode of a new interactive object which extends the list of signatures and types. Definition of new display types is handled by calling the presentation algorithms provided by the StdPrs package.
class.description: ! A framework to manage 3D displays, graphic entities and their updates. ! Used in the AIS package (Application Interactive Services), to enable the advanced user to ! define the default display mode of a new interactive object which extends the list of signatures ! and types. Definition of new display types is handled by calling the presentation algorithms ! provided by the StdPrs package.

method.name: PrsMgr_PresentationManager
method.description: Creates a framework to manage displays and graphic entities with the 3D view theStructureManager.

method.name: Display
method.description: Displays the presentation of the object in the given Presentation manager with the given mode. The mode should be enumerated by the object which inherits PresentableObject.

method.name: Erase
method.description: erases the presentation of the object in the given Presentation manager with the given mode. If is -1, then erases all presentations of the object.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the presentation of the presentable object thePrsObject in this framework with the display mode theMode.

method.name: SetVisibility
method.description: Sets the visibility of presentable object.

method.name: Unhighlight
method.description: Removes highlighting from the presentation of the presentable object.

method.name: SetDisplayPriority
method.description: Sets the display priority theNewPrior of the presentable object thePrsObject in this framework with the display mode theMode.

method.name: DisplayPriority
method.description: Returns the display priority of the presentable object thePrsObject in this framework with the display mode theMode.

method.name: SetZLayer
method.description: Set Z layer ID for all presentations of the object.

method.name: GetZLayer
method.description: Get Z layer ID assigned to all presentations of the object. Method returns -1 value if object has no presentations and is impossible to get layer index.

method.name: IsHighlighted
method.description: Returns true if the presentation of the presentable object thePrsObject in this framework with the display mode theMode is highlighted.

method.name: Update
method.description: Updates the presentation of the presentable object thePrsObject in this framework with the display mode theMode.

method.name: BeginImmediateDraw
method.description: Resets the transient list of presentations previously displayed in immediate mode and begins accumulation of new list by following AddToImmediateList()/Color()/Highlight() calls.

method.name: ClearImmediateDraw
method.description: Resets the transient list of presentations previously displayed in immediate mode.

method.name: AddToImmediateList
method.description: Stores thePrs in the transient list of presentations to be displayed in immediate mode. Will be taken in account in EndImmediateDraw method.

method.name: EndImmediateDraw
method.description: Allows rapid drawing of the each view in theViewer by avoiding an update of the whole background.

method.name: RedrawImmediate
method.description: Clears and redisplays immediate structures of the viewer taking into account its affinity.

method.name: IsImmediateModeOn
method.description: Returns true if Presentation Manager is accumulating transient list of presentations to be displayed in immediate mode.

method.name: Color
method.description: Highlights the graphic object thePrsObject in the color theColor. thePrsObject has the display mode theMode; this has the default value of 0, that is, the wireframe display mode.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Sets the transformation theTransformation for the presentable object thePrsObject. thePrsObject has the display mode theMode; this has the default value of 0, that is, the wireframe display mode.

method.name: StructureManager
method.description: Returns the structure manager.

method.name: HasPresentation
method.description: Returns true if there is a presentation of the presentable object thePrsObject in this framework, thePrsObject having the display mode theMode.

method.name: Presentation
method.description: Returns the presentation Presentation of the presentable object thePrsObject in this framework. When theToCreate is true - automatically creates presentation for specified mode when not exist. Optional argument theSelObj specifies parent decomposed object to inherit its view affinity.

method.name: UpdateHighlightTrsf
method.description: Allows to apply location transformation to shadow highlight presentation immediately.
